answers.question: Can I do all three runs next week and add the two I missed?
answers.answer: Yes, you can add the missed runs, but keep them easy and listen to how your body feels.

new.analysis:
The athlete missed two scheduled runs, still recovering from a mild cold, and wants to add them. Since the goal is a build phase, keep total volume modest and avoid high‑intensity work. Add an easy run on Wednesday and Saturday to substitute the missed Monday and Saturday sessions, but keep the distance and pace low and watch for lingering cough or fatigue. Two consecutive rest days (Thu‑Fri) give extra recovery time. The total weekly mileage stays under 20 km, which is safe for someone new to running who just had a bout of illness. Also advise to keep heart rate under about 150 bpm on easy runs and to consider resting if symptoms worsen.

No red flags for serious injury. Provide a brief safety note in case symptoms persist.
